name: Stripe backend engineer
notes: Realistic ~1500 char JD — fintech, remote-friendly, TypeScript + Go, senior IC track.

inputs.text:
Senior Backend Engineer — Stripe (Remote / San Francisco, Dublin, Singapore)

Stripe builds economic infrastructure for the internet. Businesses of every size — from new startups to public companies like Salesforce and Facebook — use our software to accept payments and manage their businesses online.

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Payments Infrastructure team you will:
- Design, build, and operate the systems that route billions of dollars per year through card networks, ACH, SEPA and local rails.
- Ship in TypeScript on Node.js with Postgres (and some Go for the highest-throughput services).
- Own systems end-to-end: API design, database schema, monitoring, incident response, and long-term evolution.
- Partner closely with Product on the merchant experience and with Compliance on regulatory changes.

We are looking for engineers with:
- 6+ years of backend experience shipping production systems at scale.
- Deep familiarity with distributed systems fundamentals — idempotency, transactions, replication, eventual consistency.
- Experience with Postgres at 10M+ rows: query planning, indexing, partitioning.
- Strong written and verbal communication.

Nice to have:
- Direct payments experience (PCI DSS, 3DS, card networks).
- Contributions to open source infrastructure.

Benefits:
- Fully remote OR any of our hubs.
- Comprehensive medical, dental, vision.
- Visa sponsorship for global hires.
- 16-week parental leave.
- $2,000/year learning budget.
- Equity + performance bonus.

Stripe is an equal opportunity employer.
